newsitem.title: LATVIA: SECURITIES WATCHDOG STRUCTURE, BOARD APPROVED.
newsitem.headline: SECURITIES WATCHDOG STRUCTURE, BOARD APPROVED.

text.p: The securities commission on Tuesday said it has approved the initial line-up of its board and structure.
Maris Grinbergs is to head the issuers' supervision department and Tatjana Kuleshova has been chosen to lead its market supervision department, the commission said in a statement.
The commission, the state watchdog of the financial markets, had its first board members approved by the parliament earlier this month, making it capable of decision-making.
"The names of the remaining candidates have been submitted to the budget and finance committee of the parliament for approval," Talis Laizans, the board chairman, told Reuters.
"I would rather not give any names before the parliament does," he said.
"The coimmission has already employed 12 people and plan to have a staff of 20 by the end of 1997," Laizans said.
